releaseApproval.reviewer: Patch continuation of the user-requested mobile playback release following the iOS 27 / 323 MB MP4 failure report; persistent format contracts reviewed unchanged
evidence: Fixes confirmed stream backpressure and Service Worker update-readiness defects, reduces startup reads, normalizes relay MIME without modifying authenticated metadata, and adds safe playback diagnostics. Persistent encryption, SQLite, backup and client mutation formats remain unchanged from v1.3.7.

Full local make test passed with 556 frontend tests, Go vet/tests, installer/update and format contract checks, plus TLS proxy tests. A supplementary web-check passed after the final equivalent MIME validation cleanup. The regression tests reproduced the lost concurrent pull and stale-controller admission on the preceding code; the corrected code passes cancellation, lifecycle and diagnostic privacy checks.

Local WebKit 26.6 iPhone emulation over loopback HTTPS passed real encrypted upload, native play and seek of a 323 MiB tail-moov H.264 MP4 padded with a free box, simulated background return restoring 1.1 seconds without autoplay, and a 410 response for the old media URL. This is not a content-heavy large-video or iOS 27 real-device certification; the user original file is unavailable locally.

User reports immediate repeatable v2.0.2 failure. Exact device/file diagnosis remains pending; the patch exposes the failed phase and provides a whitelist-only diagnostic copy without names, keys or media session URLs.
Publication requires exact-commit main CI with all-package race tests and Linux amd64/arm64 builds, followed by release archive checksum verification.

scope: XDrive v2.0.3 encrypted video startup reliability, bounded streaming backpressure, worker update readiness and playback diagnostics; persistent data formats unchanged

meaning.2: K_data hierarchy for newly encrypted files and thumbnails

localState.plaintextPolicy: encrypted with K_local before IndexedDB persistence

sqlite.migrationPolicy: forward only; after a schema-changing migration, restore the matching pre-migration database and binary before rollback

clientMutationProtocol.acceptance: exact match only; reject missing, older, and future versions before reading mutation bodies

evolutionPolicy: Unknown payload versions and unknown fields remain fail-closed.
The listed optional fields and their absent-value meanings are part of the current schema contract.
Adding or redefining a payload field requires a new payload schema version; it must not silently expand an older strict reader.
A change that makes a stale client unsafe for mutations increments the client mutation protocol version in Go and TypeScript.
Key derivation or AAD meaning changes use their own crypto version; they do not reuse a payload schema number.
SQLite schema migration, backup container format, encrypted object envelope, and browser payload schema are independent version dimensions.
